title: session.state
description: The engine's state projection and the host's live settings. A read, not a cut through the stream: a client folds events for order and reads this for where things stand.

foreignTurn.description: The agent is running a turn of its own.

turn.description: The current turn's id, "" when none is.

waiting.description: The current turn's claim was refused by a foreign turn and waits to be claimed again; false does not mean running.

queue.description: The message queue, in send order.

err.description: The failure an activity of error stands on, "" when none.

prompted.description: A turn has been started at all.

cancelled.description: The last turn to settle ended cancelled.

armedSend.description: The armed send-now, absent when nothing is armed: its text, the queued row it re-takes ("" for text the client holds itself), the turn it replaces, and the command that armed it (clientId/commandId).

settings.description: The session's live settings: the current model and mode ("" when none), and the config options as the event codec's config section.
